constitutional_basis: Article XXIX (separate implementation from mechanism failure)
Article XXXVI §4 (repair budget = 1, second failure terminal)
Article XXXVI §6 (simulator registry; COPASI deviation justified)
simulator_deviation_justification: COPASI not installed in this environment. COPASI uses LSODA/CVODE ODE solvers internally; scipy.solve_ivp with method='LSODA' solves the same system of ODEs with the same algorithm. For compartment PK models, numerical results are identical to within floating-point tolerance. Deviation documented per Article XXXVI §6 deviation_protocol.
V3_repair_description: Full mechanistic PK model per CEO directive R310 P4. Includes: compartment volume, clearance, release kinetics, transport delay, flow removal, parameter uncertainty, patient variability, noise. Mechanistic repair, NOT threshold adjustment.

model_structure.wash_out_gate_definition: Binary gate. OPEN when CSF flow rate Q_csf_out exceeds threshold Q_threshold (mimicking shunt flow during wash-out). CLOSED otherwise. NOT tautological: gate state depends on physiological flow, not on drug concentration.

falsification_criterion.definition: Number of hours per week that C_csf > 50 ug/L (therapeutic threshold)
falsification_criterion.pass_condition: >= 80% of virtual patients achieve >= 12 hours/week of therapeutic concentration
falsification_criterion.fail_consequence: P-05 -> CEMETERY. Reusable negative knowledge: wash-out-gated release cannot achieve therapeutic CSF drug levels under realistic PK.

parameter_uncertainty.wash_out_pattern: physiological_bimodal (8h active, 16h quiet, mimicking posture-driven CSF flow)

anti_patterns_forbidden: Widening tolerance after the run (Article VIII)
